definitions: Larry W. Sonsini is an American attorney and founding partner of Wilson Sonsini Goodrich & Rosati, a prominent law firm specializing in technology and life sciences.
He is widely recognized as a leading figure in Silicon Valley's legal landscape, having advised numerous high-profile companies and entrepreneurs.
examples: Larry Sonsini co-founded Wilson Sonsini Goodrich & Rosati.
Many tech giants have sought counsel from Larry Sonsini.
Larry Sonsini is a respected name in corporate law.
